summary: convert_error panics when formatting an end-of-input error after parsing 'a' while expecting 'b': without a preceding newline, line_begin incorrectly becomes the error offset, and extracting a line from the empty suffix unwraps None. The fix defaults line_begin to zero and safely handles an empty line iterator. The existing regression test, updated by this fix, checks the formatted diagnostic. It is a top-level test in tests/issues.rs; that integration target requires alloc and regexp_macros features.
